Target: Apple (AAPL). Apple develops and sells personal computing devices including iPhone, Mac and iPad, with operating systems and digital services.

Focal announcement: Introducing Apple Sports, a new app for sports fans.

Decision cutoff: 2024-02-21T23:59:59-05:00. Only information available before this cutoff is admissible.

Source: Introducing Apple Sports, a new app for sports fans. Published: 2024-02-21. URL: https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2024/02/introducing-apple-sports-a-new-app-for-sports-fans.

Condensed source facts; other details are omitted: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced Apple Sports, a free app for iPhone that gives sports fans access to real-time scores, stats, and more. Apple Sports is available to download now in the App Store in the U.S., the U.K. and Canada. “Apple Sports is available for free in the App Store, and makes it easy for users to stay up to date with their favorite teams and leagues.” Fans can easily navigate between scores and upcoming games; explore play-by-play information, team stats, lineup details, and live betting odds; 1 and tap to go to the Apple TV app to watch live games from Apple and connected streaming apps. 2 Apple Sports will also seamlessly sync with favorites selected within the My Sports experience including in the Apple TV app and Apple News. Apple Sports is free to download, and is available for all iPhone models running iOS 17.2 or later.

The exact historical text version is unverified. This is an incomplete source-based reconstruction.

The previously fitted market-only reference model favored an upward return beyond the neutral band. Its leading outcome was only slightly favored. It still assigned meaningful possibility to a return inside the narrow neutral band and a downward return beyond the neutral band. This is a training-only model forecast, not an observed outcome or independent news evidence.

The neutral return band's half-width is narrower than the code-computed ordinary five-session variability scale. An irrelevant article does not eliminate ordinary price movement; this is not a calculated class probability.

Forecast target: entry is the first regular-session open after the cutoff; exit is the fifth session close, counting entry as session one. Raw return above +1% is up; within inclusive -1% to +1% is flat; below -1% is down. The initial pre-entry reaction is outside this target.

Do not invent analyst consensus, incremental target sales, new corporate cash payments, or an already-priced news reaction.
